verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents an Admin/Management API for creating, updating and deleting projects, environments, flags, segments and users, and states that anything possible in the dashboard can also be done via the API. It also documents a public Flags API authenticated by an environment key, and its official MCP server and CLI give programmatic access to the Admin API. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), no llms.txt, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of API completeness.
